title: BikeLab PSI Calculator: Bicycle Tire Pressure (Road/Gravel Constant-Deflection Model and MTB Model) — Engines, Golden Vectors and Verifiers
description:
Calculation engines of the BikeLab PSI Calculator (online since 12 June 2026 at bikelabstudio.com, in Spanish, English and Portuguese), copied byte for byte from the live page: a road/gravel constant-deflection model (Frank Berto's 15 % tire drop with a real-width correction from a 321-tire census, documented in DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20671797) and an MTB model fitted to the public SRAM/Zipp guide. Includes golden vectors, an independent Python verifier written from the white paper that reproduces its six published cross-validation cases, a Node.js check of both real engines, and a live comparison against the SRAM AXS guide (2026-11-23) with its known limit declared.

This is the first release archived from GitHub; versions 1.0 and 2.0 were deposited manually under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20673124. The original oracle scripts were not preserved; the verifiers were written on 2026-11-23 and are declared as such.
